works.body:
Thank you for your continued support! I'm Komari Saiki, an illustrator and VTuber. I saw you're accepting requests on Skeb, and I'd love to commission you, so I'm sending this request! 【Usage】 For use within the scope of my activities, such as SNS and stream thumbnails, or distributing wallpapers for memberships. (Will not be used for merchandise sales, etc.) 【About the Character】 ・A sheep character ・Sleepy, slightly droopy eyes ・Height: 156cm ・Hair color is a light milk-cocoa shade, but the hair on the ears and tail is white ・Left-handed, so if holding a pen, please have them hold it in their left hand 【About the Illustration】 ・Basic style: A simple, cute, and slightly quirky design ・Color scheme: Light, pastel colors with a touch of brown ・Style: A clean, simple line art style with minimal shading ・Size: A standard illustration size (approximately 300x300px) Height: 156cm ・Hair color is a light, milky cocoa shade, but the fur on her ears and tail is white ・She is left-handed, so if she holds a pen, please have her hold it in her left hand 【Illustration Details】 I'd like to leave the basic design up to you! 【Delivery Format】 A PSD file would be helpful for easy use in thumbnails, etc.! (It would be helpful if the character and background are separate layers!) That's all. Thank you for considering my request!
